name: tool_brute
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. Redesign the reference into a clearly distinct TALL goblin warrior armory stall. Broad square rack, giant battered round shield emblem high above, heavy clubs and a short cleaver securely hanging separately, an iron-rimmed shield on the counter, muted brick-red short banner. Chunky grounded legs. No archery targets or coins.
review: accepted: round shield crest, clubs and cleaver rack; no hand conflicts; non-pixel painted transparent static bitmap
